command: PY="${HOME}/.local/share/opencode-sglang-stack/venv/bin/python"; if [ ! -x "$PY" ]; then PY="python3"; fi; exec "$PY" -m harness.mcp.vault_server
PY="${HOME}/.local/share/opencode-sglang-stack/venv/bin/python"; if [ ! -x "$PY" ]; then PY="python3"; fi; exec "$PY" -m harness.mcp.worktree_server

supreme-orchestrator.description: Single human-facing primary: triages requirements, awaits human agreement, then delegates to exactly one per-issue team-orchestrator; never spawns leaves, edits files, runs tests, or merges

team-orchestrator.description: Per-issue team orchestrator: plans, awaits approval, then dispatches and coordinates the agent team; the only agent allowed to spawn leaves; never merges

architect.description: Subsystem design, codebase surveys, high-context refactor blueprints, and dependency topology; calls scout for searches

worker.description: Implementation, refactoring, test authoring, and commits; calls grunt and scout

tester.description: Runs the TDD pipeline, fixes failures, and verifies behavior; calls grunt and scout

reviewer.description: Adversarial code reviewer and security gatekeeper; calls scout only for searches

scout.description: Read-only 9B search subagent: grep, file discovery, large-scale context consolidation

grunt.description: 9B leaf subagent: atomic simple edits, localized checks, small searches

summary.description: Commit summary and change log synthesis
